title: Multi wallet
tagline: A smart multichain wallet to manage multiple addresses and tokens seamlessly across blockchains.
description: Our platform is a next-generation multichain crypto wallet that allows users to manage multiple addresses and a wide variety of tokens seamlessly across different blockchains. With cross-chain functionality, users can send, receive, and track their assets without switching apps or networks, making crypto management simpler, faster, and more secure. Designed for both casual users and power users, it provides a unified interface to oversee all your crypto holdings, optimize transactions, and interact with decentralized applications effortlessly.
how_its_made: Built as a full-stack multichain crypto wallet, we leveraged React for the front-end, TypeScript for type safety, and Viem for interacting with Ethereum-compatible chains. Cross-chain functionality uses custom bridging logic and APIs like Stargate and ARC. Wallet management supports multiple addresses and token types, while smart contracts handle secure transfers. We integrated real-time balance fetching, optimized gas estimation, and implemented a modular architecture for scalability. Some clever hacks include batching cross-chain transactions to minimize fees and using private key management securely in the client.
